releaseNotes: 20.11.0: fixes duplicate home-screen control IDs so every visible sidebar toggle and command-search button responds, and keeps every profile coin/avatar header synchronized. The daily drop buttons share one claim handler. Shared local-profile rewards now include Battle World, Battle Pass missions, Player Journey, Black Zone evacuations, NEXUS World Expansion, NEXUS World bosses and NEXUS Evolution. Existing local mode saves remain; no new online server.
